sentences.text: Hmph. The notion of a haunting is unsubstantiated, as the data only shows a localized humidity spike in the ironing room.
The humidity observed reached 35.5 % between 05:40 and 06:00, which is significantly higher than the expected range of 29.5 % to 32.0 %.
I probably suggest that this sudden increase was caused by steam or moisture from an activity taking place in the ironing room.
Without any other sensor events, the evidence points toward a mundane physical occurrence rather than any spectral disturbance.
